profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Quest Defense
profile.summary: Mercer University alumni who is passionate about developing software applications and products.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Warner Robins, Georgia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Lead the design, development, and integration of mission-critical aircraft software applications using C++ and Qt Creator in a Linux-based development environment. 

Develop and maintain both front-end user interfaces and back-end application logic supporting avionics and aircraft mission systems. 

Architect and implement scalable software components, improving system performance, maintainability, and reliability across multiple aircraft platforms. 

Lead code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and promote software engineering best practices across the development team.

Utilize GitLab for source control, merge request reviews, issue tracking, and CI/CD pipeline management to ensure code quality and traceability.

Investigated and resolved complex software defects identified during integration and qualification testing, improving system reliability and reducing rework.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Warner Robins, Georgia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Participated in the full life cycle of software development, including application development, modular testing, integration, formal system testing, release, installation, and upgrades

Designed, implemented, maintained, and tested embedded software supporting aircraft guidance, navigation, and control functionality

Translated system and subsystem requirements into reliable C++ software in compliance with program and aerospace standards

Used GitLab for version control, code reviews, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines execution

Documented software designs, interfaces, and test procedures to support certification and long-term maintainability

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with the automated test team to create, modify, and test scripts to successfully identify any bugs within software. In doing so, I was able to help improve the success rate of previously failing test scripts by more than 40%.

Developed user interfaces for embedded software applications using C++ and Qt Integrated Development Environment

Researched different softwares and ways to integrate automated testing onto a completely new project

Coordinated with team members on ways to improve the testing process, making the process run more smoothly

Gained exposure to EW and Avionic systems
